parent_conclusion: Training-only private-strength profiling controls strong-private type-I error on both failed development geometries, but the old universal power gate fails because positive-control detectability is strongly geometry-dependent and remains near the matched-oracle ceiling.

qualification_architecture.principle: Separate inferential validity from finite-design detectability. Type-I validity is a method property to confirm across fresh external geometries. Power is a property of a specific sampling design and must be checked prospectively on each deployment geometry before empirical trait outcomes are opened.

gate_v_external_validity.purpose: Confirm that the profiled-private inference controls false sharedness under strong species-private transitions on fresh geometry, without selecting or excluding geometries by their power.
gate_v_external_validity.pass_rule: BOTH fresh validity panels must have maximum zero-shared Wilson 95% upper bound <= 0.10. No power or observability result may be used to drop, replace, or exempt a declared panel.

gate_d_deployment_adequacy.purpose: Before any empirical trait outcome is opened on a deployment geometry, verify that this exact design both remains locally calibrated and has enough power for the prespecified moderate shared transition.
gate_d_deployment_adequacy.pass_rule: On the deployment geometry, maximum zero-shared Wilson 95% upper bound <= 0.10 AND full-shared A=2 Wilson 95% lower bound >= 0.80.
gate_d_deployment_adequacy.failure_interpretation: The design is non-qualifying / underpowered for this estimand. Do not interpret absence of rejection as evidence of no sharedness and do not open the empirical trait outcome under TTF.

legacy_holdout_firewall.reason: Do not retroactively change their qualification role after seeing v07 power failures.

claim_boundary: A Gate-V pass establishes false-positive validity of the v07 profiled-private inference on fresh external geometries. It does not establish universal power. A Gate-D pass is additionally required for each concrete deployment geometry before empirical sharedness inference is permitted.
